composers_checked.note: All 182 candidate pages handled. Floor evidence from Apple Music track lists (iTunes Search API, one query per TWV number, 238 queries) and MusicBrainz; minutes are the median per-album total of matching tracks. Gap check against MusicBrainz's 5,251 Telemann works and all TWV 42-44 numbers seen on Apple Music: added the Concerto polonois TWV 43:B3; TWV 43:D7 (trumpet, 2 oboes), 42:c7, 42:e6, 42:a6, 42:F14, 42:C1 have no string part; 42:F15 (recorder, oboe or violin) left open.

note: Telemann, continuo and winds-with-strings formations: all 182 candidate pages handled. Floor evidence is Apple Music track metadata (iTunes Search API, one query per TWV number) and MusicBrainz (5,251 Telemann works browsed with recording links); track labels were filtered against collection names because some albums mislabel TWV numbers (Musica Ad Rhenum labels the Paris Quartets as TWV 43:e5, D6, A6, a5, G2; one "Musique de table" album as 43:A7 and 43:g3). Three works kept on MusicBrainz evidence alone (TWV 42:f2, 42:g13, 43:B2; low or medium confidence). Kept as chamber music, assuming one player to a part as Telemann's TWV 43/44 chamber categories imply: the Concerti à 4 for strings (some recorded only by small orchestras, e.g. TWV 43:E2 by Arion), the Concerti à 7 (TWV 44:41-43) and the Sinfonia spirituosa TWV 44:1 (optional trumpet). Open problems: (1) Six Concerts et six suites (1734): only the suites TWV 42:a3 and d3 are confirmed recorded in Telemann's alternative for flute, violin and continuo; the other ten (recorded complete by Camerata Köln, scoring unchecked) are skipped as duos. (2) Gap candidates not added because their scoring could not be confirmed: TWV 42:F7, F9, F16, G13, 43:C3, D8, F8 (all recorded). TWV 43:D7 is for trumpet, 2 oboes and continuo (no strings), 42:c7 is for recorder and oboe; 42:F15 is for recorder and oboe (or violin), recorded by Tripla Concordia with scoring unchecked. (3) Essercizii trios with obbligato harpsichord (TWV 42:G6) skipped as duos. (4) Durations are medians of per-album sums of matching tracks; single-track recordings left minutes empty. Levels are estimates calibrated on the Paris Quartet benchmark (5). BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 3 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Telemann: Trio Sonata in G minor, TWV 42:g13; Telemann: Concerto à 4 in E major, TWV 43:E2; Telemann: Quartet in B-flat major, TWV 43:B2.
